# NativeSelect

Use `NativeSelect` when browser-native selection behavior, mobile pickers, and
low interaction cost matter most. Compose `NativeSelectOption` directly, or
group related choices with `NativeSelectOptGroup`. Use `aria-invalid` for an
invalid control and provide its visible label through `FormField` or `Label`.
